{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_le_two_pow",
      "informal_name": "$\\binom{n}{k} \\leq 2^n$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), n.choose k ≤ 2 ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\\binom{n}{k}$ is less than or equal to $2^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_succ_le_two_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n+1}{k} \\leq 2^n$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), (n + 1).choose k ≤ 2 ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\\binom{n+1}{k}$ is less than or equal to $2^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_lt_two_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n}{k} < 2^n$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → n.choose k < 2 ^ n",
      "informal_description": "For any positive integer $n$ and natural number $k$, the binomial coefficient $\\binom{n}{k}$ is strictly less than $2^n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_le_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n}{k} \\leq n^k$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), n.choose k ≤ n ^ k",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\\binom{n}{k}$ is less than or equal to $n^k$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.choose_lt_pow",
      "informal_name": "Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\\binom{n}{k} < n^k$ for $k \\geq 2$ and $n \\neq 0$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {n k : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ k → n.choose k < n ^ k",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $n \\neq 0$ and $2 \\leq k$, it holds that $\\binom{n}{k} < n^k$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\binom{n}{k}$ is less than or equal to $2^n$.
For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the binomial coefficient $\binom{n+1}{k}$ is less than or equal to $2^n$.

items.informal_name: Binomial Coefficient Inequality: $\binom{n}{k} < n^k$ for $k \geq 2$ and $n \neq 0$
